title: Move SSH to 2222 with an admin user, fail2ban and auto-updates
traps: Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 socket-activates sshd: a Port line alone does not move the listener
PasswordAuthentication yes comes from 50-cloud-init.conf, which a later drop-in cannot override
fail2ban must watch the new port and actually see failures (systemd backend, sshd-session on Debian 13)
